en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a riverside industrial town in a hilly rural landscape. In the middle ground stands a large multi‑storey factory complex with many tall windows and a single high chimney. Smaller residential buildings and farm plots surround the factory, with a river running along the right side of the image and cultivated fields in the foreground. Tree‑lined hills and scattered houses extend into the distance. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.
